RSI-14 at 27.106 confirms deeply oversold conditions and elevated rebound risk.
A conditional short near 155.50 targets 151.50, invalidated above the 158.403 MA20.

FX.comment: A rebound short near 155.50 targets 151.50 while the price remains below the 158.403 MA20.
